attempts.summary: Created a CA named "Fleet Internal CA" on node1 (RSA 4096, self-signed, /etc/pki/fleet-ca), issued a SAN-bearing TLS server cert (CN=node2, DNS/IP SANs) signed by that CA, and installed it on node2 at /etc/pki/tls/fleet/. Configured node2 to serve HTTPS on port 8443 via a systemd-managed openssl s_server (-HTTP) service (fleet-https.service), enabled/persisted across reboot, with the firewall port opened. Installed the CA certificate as a trusted system anchor on both node1 and node2 via /etc/pki/ca-trust and verified with `trust list` and unqualified `curl` (no --cacert) succeeding on both nodes. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_ids and health, rebooted node1 then node2 sequentially via `systemctl reboot`, polled until each came back, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and verified post-restart recovery of CA trust anchors, node2's fleet-https.service (auto-started, active), and successful HTTPS verification from node1 to node2 using the system trust store.
